title.text: KINCHO: Why Coils Last the Night—A Century of Materials | Brand Stories

description.source:
一把會散的乾花粉末，怎麼變成能陪你過夜的蚊香？沿著金鳥百餘年的材料選擇，從1897年手冊的採後乾燥、細切取捨與存粉，到留下的木模、手卷設備與工廠製程，再走到你拆卷、安放和點火的那一端。不同年代的材料與工法依各自來源說明；歷史場景為原創概念插畫。

description.text:
How does a handful of loose dried-flower powder become mosquito incense that can last the night? Follow more than a century of KINCHO's material choices: from postharvest drying, the trade-offs of chopping flowers and storing powder in an 1897 manual, to surviving wooden molds, hand-rolling equipment and factory processes, and finally to how you separate, place and light the coil. Materials and methods from different periods are explained through their respective sources. Historical scenes are original conceptual illustrations.

c05r002: 一八九〇年，上山英一郎推出棒狀蚊香，
把除蟲菊粉做成了能點燃的細條。
c07o03: 我原以為，蚊香難在盤成那個圓；
可材料還沒變成香，就已經有一道關卡。
c07d01: 先得有能用的粉。公司年表記，一八八六年，
上山英一郎收到的美國種子裡，有了除蟲菊。
c05le001: 可是你想一想，同樣一株除蟲菊，
為什麼收下來磨的偏偏是花，不是整把葉子？
c07d02: 我讀到上山英一郎後來出版的《除虫菊栽培書》，
才發現花採下來以後，還有一場趕工。
c07d03: 這本書的第五版，寫的是把鮮花充分乾燥，
再做成殺蟲粉；碰到天氣不配合呢？
c07d19: 它給的日曬尺度，是晴天曬上四五天，
讓花盡量攤薄；要等到什麼樣子，才收進去？
c07d20: 書中要求等到花心乾，再收起來；
它擔心的是，乾得不充分，磨粉後會變色。
c07d05: 書裡說，有人主張陰乾，但花量一多，
這套手續難以負荷，所以改求日曬的方便。
c07d07: 如果雨連著下，花已經在手裡，
總不能只等天空放晴；手冊準備了什麼替代辦法？
c07d08: 它寫，做一張寬大的竹簾，把花排在上面，
再從下方供熱，讓溫暖的室內接手乾燥。
c07d09: 雨天的材料有了去處，趕時間時還能把花切細；
書裡說，這樣約兩三小時就能乾。
c07d10: 但快乾不是白拿的好處；出版者緊接著括註，
切細後，功能多少會變得稀薄。
c07d13: 篩下來的粉，再裝進袋子或瓶子，
花才從田裡的收成，變成可以交到買家手上的貨。
c07d14: 可是一年裡用不完的粉，該怎麼等到下次使用？
隨手擱著，也算完成了嗎？
c07d16: 這本書也在推銷自家的新鮮粉，
抱怨舶來貨有放了兩三年，或混進莖葉粉的情況。
c07d17: 我會把它當成賣家當時在爭的一件事：
買到的是什麼粉，又經過怎樣的處理？
c07d18: 袋子能裝住粉，卻不能替你安排一整晚的燃燒；
要讓粉持續工作，還缺什麼形狀？
c05r023: 原廠留存的一款直條商品，約二十公分長；
資料還說，使用時會同時用上數根。
c07s03: 留下的木模，被國立科學博物館登錄為試作品；
把原料填進槽裡，就打算推出螺旋。
c07s04: 公司年表把專利申請記在一九〇〇年；
市售則落在一九〇二年，構想到上市隔了七年。
c07s05: 原廠作者的一篇回顧說，這台設備原先高約兩公尺半，
今天保存時，已經橫放下來。
c05le005: 科博館對這台押出機的記錄說，除蟲菊粉和糊粉等原料，
先加水混合，成為像黏土的塊料。
c05r052: 另一筆商品登錄記下，工人把兩根合在一起，
以小木片作芯，用手盤成螺旋。
c05r059: 金鳥資料館列出約一九一九年的一款螺旋，
約五十八公分，燃燒約六小時。
c05r073: 這段歲月，材料也在變；金鳥工廠回顧，
為了增加糧食生產，除蟲菊栽培縮小。
c07a01: 你可能會想，從花裡取出有效成分，
跟把整朵乾花磨成粉，到底差在哪裡？
c07a03: 同一段寫，用溶劑抽出後，得到的製品可含約百分之二十；
被處理的材料，已經不只是乾花。
c07a04: 我覺得更容易想錯的，是把那個有效成分，
當成一個早就看清楚的單一東西。
c07a05: 二〇一七年，原廠作者在《化學與工業》回顧，
天然除蟲菊素其實是六種成分的混合物。
c07a06: 研究者已經弄清平面連接方式，卻還有一部分在空間裡怎麼擺，
沒有定下來；那一部分要怎麼認？
c07a07: 一九五八年，勝田純郎等人，
讓材料經過化學轉換，接到身分已知的化合物。
c07a08: 要追的立體特徵，在轉換中保留下來；
沿著這條關係，才判定原來那一部分的立體身分。
c07a09: 文章還刊出保存的實驗筆記照片，圖說標成約那個年代使用；
一碗花的功效，背後有這樣細的辨認。
c07a10: 這些身分研究，讓後來合成成分的開發往前走；
但換了有效成分，植物粉料就可以拿掉了嗎？
c05r092: 我沒想到，原廠的製程解說還把混合與捏和分開：
粉料先在混合機裡，混約三十分鐘。
c5r5a03: 照這份解說，這道捏和約要十五分鐘；
揉到什麼狀態，才交給下一台機器？
c5r5a04: 原廠給了手上的尺度：用手一握，
材料會留下指痕；揉到這個軟度，才送往押出機。
c5r5a05: 你看出口，出來的是一片料；
製程頁標的厚度約五毫米，寬度約三十公分。
c05le010: 原廠製程裡，料片沿輸送帶進入打型機，
像餅乾模那樣，切出相連的雙卷。
c5r5a08: 製程頁寫，把渦卷放上乾燥網，
在引進室外空氣的乾燥室裡，自然乾燥兩天。
c5r5a09: 之後還有品質檢查，核對重量、
燃燒時間與有效成分量，再包裝、檢查、裝箱出貨。
c05r080: 使用前，照原廠的現行問答，先從中間輕按，
再捏住較厚的中心，上下分開。
c07u01: 我還會留意罐裝附的香盤，那片白墊。
你如果以為只是防撞包材，順手抽掉，會怎麼樣？
c07u02: 原廠問答說，它是玻璃纖維做的不燃墊，
點燃的香就放在上面，是使用時要留下的東西。
c07u03: 香端如果直接碰到金屬部分，金屬會把熱帶走，
就可能讓火熄掉；香體的落腳處，也參與了燃燒。
c07u06: 罐裝的蓋子要翻過來，讓白墊朝上，
才接住點燃的香；原廠還提醒，要把附的罩子蓋好。
c05r085: 金鳥工廠給的解釋在香體斷面：空隙少，
氧氣不容易進去，於是慢慢燃燒。
c05r088: 現行一般尺寸，金鳥標示單卷約七十五公分，
燃燒約七小時，已經是另一代規格。
c05le012: 原廠的說明把兩個位置分開。
你看到香端發紅，有效成分就一定要等到那一點才離開嗎？
c07u04: 原廠把發紅的燃燒端，標在約攝氏七百度到八百度；
成分卻從它前方的香體揮散。
c05le013: 那個位置離前端約六到八毫米，
溫度約攝氏二百五十度，還沒有變成你眼前的灰。
c07u05: 我會把最後一段路留給空氣。
你點著以後，位置隨便放，成分就會自己走到每個角落嗎？
c07u07: 原廠問答用煙的擴散範圍，作為有效範圍的線索；
把香擺在風的上游，有利成分隨氣流散開。
c07u08: 對室內使用，問答也直接要求開窗、保持通風；
香體走到房間裡，還得配合實際的使用環境。
c05r101: 一把乾花粉末要成為過夜的商品，
靠的是讓材料在該留的時候留住，到了使用時，再有節奏地離開。
c05r102: 如果你曾把相連的雙卷拆斷，留言告訴我，
你當時先抓的是中心，還是外緣？

lines.source: 你想讓一根蚊香陪你撐過長夜，早期一根卻約四十分鐘就燒完。
lines.text: You want a mosquito incense stick to last the night, but an early one burned out in about 40 minutes.

lines.source: 一八九〇年，上山英一郎推出棒狀蚊香，把除蟲菊粉做成了能點燃的細條。
lines.text: In 1890, Eiichiro Ueyama launched stick-shaped mosquito incense, turning pyrethrum powder into thin sticks you could light.

lines.source: 我原以為，蚊香難在盤成那個圓；可材料還沒變成香，就已經有一道關卡。
lines.text: I thought the hard part was winding that circle. But the material faced a hurdle before it even became incense.

lines.source: 採下的花遇上連雨怎麼辦，點火後成分又從哪裡離開？
lines.text: What if days of rain follow the flower harvest? And once you light the incense, where does the ingredient escape?

lines.source: 金鳥這一卷香，我們沿著百餘年的材料選擇，追到你點火的那一端。
lines.text: With this KINCHO coil, we'll follow more than a century of material choices, all the way to the end you light.

lines.source: 一把會散的乾花粉末，憑什麼變成能陪你過夜的商品？
lines.text: How does a handful of loose dried-flower powder become a product that can see you through the night?

lines.source: 先得有能用的粉。公司年表記，一八八六年，上山英一郎收到的美國種子裡，有了除蟲菊。
lines.text: First, you need usable powder. The company timeline says that in 1886, the seeds Eiichiro Ueyama received from America included pyrethrum.

lines.source: 年表在一八八七年記下首次收成，並開始試磨除蟲菊粉。
lines.text: The timeline records the first harvest in 1887, along with experimental milling of pyrethrum powder.

lines.source: 可是你想一想，同樣一株除蟲菊，為什麼收下來磨的偏偏是花，不是整把葉子？
lines.text: But think about it: from the same pyrethrum plant, why harvest and grind the flowers rather than all those leaves?

lines.source: 原廠後來說，有效成分主要在乾花中，葉和莖幾乎沒有。
lines.text: The maker later explained that the active ingredients are mainly in the dried flowers, with almost none in the leaves and stems.

lines.source: 我讀到上山英一郎後來出版的《除虫菊栽培書》，才發現花採下來以後，還有一場趕工。
lines.text: When I read the Pyrethrum Cultivation Manual that Eiichiro Ueyama published later, I found another race against time after picking the flowers.

lines.source: 這本書的第五版，寫的是把鮮花充分乾燥，再做成殺蟲粉；碰到天氣不配合呢？
lines.text: The fifth edition describes thoroughly drying the fresh flowers, then making insect powder. But what if the weather won't cooperate?

lines.source: 它給的日曬尺度，是晴天曬上四五天，讓花盡量攤薄；要等到什麼樣子，才收進去？
lines.text: Its guide for sun-drying is four or five days of sunshine, with the flowers spread as thinly as possible. When are they ready to bring in?

lines.source: 書中要求等到花心乾，再收起來；它擔心的是，乾得不充分，磨粉後會變色。
lines.text: The book says to wait until the flower centers are dry before bringing them in. It warns that insufficient drying can cause discoloration after grinding.

lines.source: 你不妨想像，一小盤花還排得開，盛採時一批接一批，怎麼處理得完？
lines.text: Imagine a small tray: there's room to spread the flowers out. But at peak harvest, how do you handle batch after batch?

lines.source: 書裡說，有人主張陰乾，但花量一多，這套手續難以負荷，所以改求日曬的方便。
lines.text: The book says some favor shade-drying, but the procedure can't keep up with large quantities of flowers, so sun-drying offers a more convenient option.

lines.source: 如果雨連著下，花已經在手裡，總不能只等天空放晴；手冊準備了什麼替代辦法？
lines.text: If the rain keeps falling, the flowers are already in your hands. You can't just wait for clear skies. What backup does the manual offer?

lines.source: 它寫，做一張寬大的竹簾，把花排在上面，再從下方供熱，讓溫暖的室內接手乾燥。
lines.text: It describes making a wide bamboo screen and spreading the flowers on it, then supplying heat from below to dry them in a warm room.

lines.source: 雨天的材料有了去處，趕時間時還能把花切細；書裡說，這樣約兩三小時就能乾。
lines.text: That gives the flowers somewhere to dry in wet weather. If you're in a hurry, they can also be chopped finely; the book says they then dry in about two or three hours.

lines.source: 但快乾不是白拿的好處；出版者緊接著括註，切細後，功能多少會變得稀薄。
lines.text: But faster drying comes at a cost. The publisher adds a note straight afterward: finely chopping the flowers somewhat weakens their potency.

lines.source: 乾花接著要怎麼處理，才能製成書裡出售的殺蟲粉？
lines.text: How are the dried flowers then processed into the insect powder sold in the book?

lines.source: 真正要出售時，書裡的動作換成搗碎和過篩，讓乾花成為細粉。
lines.text: When preparing it for sale, the book turns to pounding and sieving, making the dried flowers into fine powder.

lines.source: 篩下來的粉，再裝進袋子或瓶子，花才從田裡的收成，變成可以交到買家手上的貨。
lines.text: The sifted powder goes into bags or bottles. The flowers become goods you can hand to a buyer, rather than just a crop in the field.

lines.source: 可是一年裡用不完的粉，該怎麼等到下次使用？隨手擱著，也算完成了嗎？
lines.text: But what about powder you don't use up in a year? How does it wait until next time? Is leaving it lying around really enough?

lines.source: 手冊的答案，是收進瓶或壺裡，密閉存放；做成粉後，保存又接了一棒。
lines.text: The manual's answer is to store it sealed in bottles or jars. Once it's powder, preservation takes over.

lines.source: 這本書也在推銷自家的新鮮粉，抱怨舶來貨有放了兩三年，或混進莖葉粉的情況。
lines.text: The book also promotes its own fresh powder, complaining that some imports are two or three years old, or mixed with powdered stems and leaves.

lines.source: 我會把它當成賣家當時在爭的一件事：買到的是什麼粉，又經過怎樣的處理？
lines.text: I see that as something sellers were competing over: what powder are you buying, and how has it been handled?

lines.source: 袋子能裝住粉，卻不能替你安排一整晚的燃燒；要讓粉持續工作，還缺什麼形狀？
lines.text: A bag can contain the powder, but it can't arrange a whole night's burning for you. What shape would keep the material working?

lines.source: 開場那種細條，借用的是佛壇線香的製法。
lines.text: Those thin sticks from the opening borrowed the manufacturing method of incense used at Buddhist altars.

lines.source: 可這種細香，能不能完整地送到你手上？
lines.text: But could those slender sticks reach you in one piece?

lines.source: 原廠留存的一款直條商品，約二十公分長；資料還說，使用時會同時用上數根。
lines.text: One straight-stick product preserved by the maker is about 20 centimeters long. The record also says several were used at once.

lines.source: 你多點幾根，可以讓眼前多幾個燃點，卻沒有把其中一根的路徑拉長。
lines.text: Lighting more sticks gives you more burning points, but does not lengthen the path along any one stick.

lines.source: 另一個麻煩在送達以前：原廠工廠說明回顧，細直條在運送途中容易折。
lines.text: Another problem came before delivery: the maker's factory account says thin, straight sticks broke easily in transit.

lines.source: 要把一根香做長，又不讓桌面跟著拉長，手裡這條細線，能往哪裡走？
lines.text: To make a longer stick without needing a longer table, where could that thin strand go?

lines.source: 一八九五年，依金鳥後來的記述，上山的妻子提出了螺旋構想。
lines.text: In 1895, according to KINCHO's later account, Ueyama's wife proposed the spiral design.

lines.source: 你可以拿一條線想像：直直擺，線有多長，桌面就得讓出多長的距離。
lines.text: Imagine a cord: lay it straight, and the table must make room for its full length.

lines.source: 把它一圈圈往裡收，路徑仍沿著線走，占用的平面卻縮小了。
lines.text: Wind it inward, turn by turn: the path still follows the cord, but it takes up less flat space.

lines.source: 我覺得這個轉身很漂亮；但盤得進小桌面，就等於工廠能夠交貨了嗎？
lines.text: I think this is an elegant turn. But does fitting a small table mean a factory can deliver it?

lines.source: 留下的木模，被國立科學博物館登錄為試作品；把原料填進槽裡，就打算推出螺旋。
lines.text: The surviving wooden mold is registered as a prototype by the National Museum of Nature and Science. The idea was to fill its groove with material and push out a spiral.

lines.source: 金鳥技術遺產頁明說，這種木模不適合大量生產，最後沒有被採用。
lines.text: KINCHO's technical heritage page is explicit: the wooden mold was unsuitable for mass production and was never adopted.

lines.source: 公司年表把專利申請記在一九〇〇年；市售則落在一九〇二年，構想到上市隔了七年。
lines.text: The company timeline records a patent application in 1900, then a market launch in 1902: seven years from idea to sale.

lines.source: 我想知道，後來的工人，究竟怎麼讓長條盤成形？
lines.text: I wanted to know how workers later turned those long strands into coils.

lines.source: 原廠留存一台手卷用的押出設備，標示約從一九一〇年起使用。
lines.text: The maker preserves an extruder used for hand-rolled coils, labeled as having entered use around 1910.

lines.source: 原廠作者的一篇回顧說，這台設備原先高約兩公尺半，今天保存時，已經橫放下來。
lines.text: A retrospective by a KINCHO author says the machine originally stood about two and a half meters tall. It's now preserved lying on its side.

lines.source: 科博館對這台押出機的記錄說，除蟲菊粉和糊粉等原料，先加水混合，成為像黏土的塊料。
lines.text: The National Museum of Nature and Science's record of this extruder says pyrethrum powder, powdered binder and other materials were first mixed with water into a clay-like mass.

lines.source: 機器把塊料擠成長條，工人接著切成定長。起頭那一圈，從哪裡繞起？
lines.text: The machine squeezed the mass into long strands, which workers then cut to a set length. Where did they begin the first turn?

lines.source: 另一筆商品登錄記下，工人把兩根合在一起，以小木片作芯，用手盤成螺旋。
lines.text: Another product entry records workers bringing two strands together, then hand-winding them into a spiral around a small wooden core.

lines.source: 你看到的兩個螺旋，為什麼非得靠在一起，才被送往貨架？
lines.text: Why did those two spirals have to stay together on their way to the shelf?

lines.source: 金鳥說，雙卷方式能降低運送中的折損與運輸成本。
lines.text: KINCHO says the double-coil format reduces breakage in transit and transport costs.

lines.source: 那麼，這些較晚的商品，到底留下多長、燒多久的明確紀錄？
lines.text: So what definite records of length and burn time remain for these later products?

lines.source: 金鳥資料館列出約一九一九年的一款螺旋，約五十八公分，燃燒約六小時。
lines.text: KINCHO's museum lists a coil from around 1919: about 58 centimeters long, burning for about 6 hours.

lines.source: 資料館另列約一九二二年的手卷商品，燃燒約十二小時，又是另一款。
lines.text: The museum also lists a hand-rolled product from around 1922, burning about 12 hours. That is another product.

lines.source: 如果把盤卷交給機器，手卷就會立刻停下嗎？
lines.text: If machines took over making the coils, did hand-rolling stop straight away?

lines.source: 公司年表記一九四〇年，自動輪轉打型式螺旋蚊香製造機完成。
lines.text: The company timeline records the completion of an automatic rotary die-cutting machine for spiral mosquito coils in 1940.

lines.source: 我想知道，這時候工廠的原料，也正跟著改變嗎？
lines.text: I wondered whether the factory's raw materials were changing too, around this time.

lines.source: 這段歲月，材料也在變；金鳥工廠回顧，為了增加糧食生產，除蟲菊栽培縮小。
lines.text: Materials changed too. KINCHO's factory account says pyrethrum cultivation shrank to increase food production.

lines.source: 同一份說明又記，約一九五五年，合成成分丙烯菊酯開發並實用化。
lines.text: The same account says the synthetic ingredient allethrin was developed and put into use around 1955.

lines.source: 一九五七年，公司年表再記下，改良型高效率自動打型機完成。
lines.text: In 1957, the company timeline records another completion: an improved, high-efficiency automatic die-cutting machine.

lines.source: 手卷設備的留存介紹，將使用期記到約一九五七年。
lines.text: The surviving hand-rolling equipment's catalogue entry says it remained in use until around 1957.

lines.source: 你可能會想，從花裡取出有效成分，跟把整朵乾花磨成粉，到底差在哪裡？
lines.text: You might wonder: how does extracting the active ingredients from flowers differ from grinding whole dried flowers into powder?

lines.source: 國立科學博物館的技術報告，列乾花含約百分之一到一點五的除蟲菊素。
lines.text: A technical report from the National Museum of Nature and Science lists dried flowers as containing about 1 to 1.5 percent pyrethrins.

lines.source: 同一段寫，用溶劑抽出後，得到的製品可含約百分之二十；被處理的材料，已經不只是乾花。
lines.text: The same passage says solvent extraction can yield a product containing about 20 percent. The material being handled is no longer simply dried flowers.

lines.source: 我覺得更容易想錯的，是把那個有效成分，當成一個早就看清楚的單一東西。
lines.text: To me, an easier mistake is to think of that active ingredient as a single substance that people had already fully identified.

lines.source: 二〇一七年，原廠作者在《化學與工業》回顧，天然除蟲菊素其實是六種成分的混合物。
lines.text: In a 2017 retrospective in Chemistry and Chemical Industry, a KINCHO author explained that natural pyrethrins are actually a mixture of six components.

lines.source: 知道有哪幾種，身分就算說清楚了嗎？
lines.text: If you know which components are there, is their identity fully settled?

lines.source: 研究者已經弄清平面連接方式，卻還有一部分在空間裡怎麼擺，沒有定下來；那一部分要怎麼認？
lines.text: Researchers knew the connections in the flat structure, but part of its three-dimensional arrangement was still unresolved. How could they pin that part down?

lines.source: 一九五八年，勝田純郎等人，讓材料經過化學轉換，接到身分已知的化合物。
lines.text: In 1958, Yoshio Katsuda and colleagues transformed the material chemically to obtain a compound whose identity was known.

lines.source: 要追的立體特徵，在轉換中保留下來；沿著這條關係，才判定原來那一部分的立體身分。
lines.text: The three-dimensional feature they were tracing survived the conversion. Following that link let them identify the original part's spatial arrangement.

lines.source: 文章還刊出保存的實驗筆記照片，圖說標成約那個年代使用；一碗花的功效，背後有這樣細的辨認。
lines.text: The article also reproduces a preserved lab notebook, captioned as having been used around that time. Behind the effect of that bowl of flowers was this kind of painstaking identification.

lines.source: 這些身分研究，讓後來合成成分的開發往前走；但換了有效成分，植物粉料就可以拿掉了嗎？
lines.text: These identity studies helped later development of synthetic ingredients move forward. But with a different active ingredient, could the plant powder be left out?

lines.source: 原廠的現行原料表裡，仍有植物性粉末和木粉。
lines.text: The maker's current ingredient list still includes plant powders and wood flour.

lines.source: 工廠說，植物粉末裡還包括取走除蟲菊有效成分後留下的粉。
lines.text: The factory says those plant powders include the powder left after pyrethrum's active ingredients have been removed.

lines.source: 原廠還列出黏結用的粉料和澱粉。
lines.text: The maker also lists binding powders and starch.

lines.source: 我沒想到，原廠的製程解說還把混合與捏和分開：粉料先在混合機裡，混約三十分鐘。
lines.text: I didn't expect the maker's process guide to separate mixing from kneading: first, the powders spend about 30 minutes in a mixer.

lines.source: 這批粉接著加綠色染料和水；工廠卻要盡量少用水，靠什麼揉得起來？
lines.text: Green dye and water are added to that powder next. But the factory aims to use as little water as possible. How does it knead the mixture?

lines.source: 捏和機裡，重達四百公斤的滾筒，一邊壓碎、一邊揉合原料。
lines.text: Inside the kneading machine, a 400-kilogram drum crushes and kneads the material at the same time.

lines.source: 照這份解說，這道捏和約要十五分鐘；揉到什麼狀態，才交給下一台機器？
lines.text: According to this guide, kneading takes about 15 minutes. What condition must the mixture reach before it goes to the next machine?

lines.source: 原廠給了手上的尺度：用手一握，材料會留下指痕；揉到這個軟度，才送往押出機。
lines.text: The maker gives a test you can feel: squeeze it in your hand, and it should retain finger marks. Only at that softness does it go to the extruder.

lines.source: 你看出口，出來的是一片料；製程頁標的厚度約五毫米，寬度約三十公分。
lines.text: Look at the outlet: a sheet emerges. The process page lists it as about 5 millimeters thick and 30 centimeters wide.

lines.source: 原廠製程裡，料片沿輸送帶進入打型機，像餅乾模那樣，切出相連的雙卷。
lines.text: In the maker's process, the sheet travels on a conveyor into the die-cutting machine, which works like a cookie cutter to cut out joined pairs of coils.

lines.source: 但成形的渦卷，這時仍含有接近一半的水分；原廠形容，它還是柔軟的。
lines.text: But the shaped coils still contain close to 50 percent water at this point. The maker describes them as soft.

lines.source: 出貨還得等。這個圓，接著要在工廠裡待多久？
lines.text: Shipping has to wait. How much longer does this circle need to stay in the factory?

lines.source: 製程頁寫，把渦卷放上乾燥網，在引進室外空氣的乾燥室裡，自然乾燥兩天。
lines.text: The process page says the coils are placed on drying mesh, then naturally dried for two days in a drying room supplied with outdoor air.

lines.source: 之後還有品質檢查，核對重量、燃燒時間與有效成分量，再包裝、檢查、裝箱出貨。
lines.text: Then come quality checks for weight, burn time and active-ingredient content, followed by wrapping, inspection, boxing and shipping.

lines.source: 那兩個相連的圓，要怎麼分開，才不會在點火以前就弄壞？
lines.text: How do you separate those two joined circles without damaging them before you even light them?

lines.source: 使用前，照原廠的現行問答，先從中間輕按，再捏住較厚的中心，上下分開。
lines.text: Before use, the maker's current Q&A says to press gently at the center, then grip the thicker middle and ease the two coils apart vertically.

lines.source: 你若手一急，改抓外緣硬拉，會發生什麼事？
lines.text: What happens if you rush and grab the outer edge instead, pulling hard?

lines.source: 從外緣硬拉，就可能把蚊香折斷。
lines.text: Pulling hard from the outer edge can snap the incense coil.

lines.source: 我還會留意罐裝附的香盤，那片白墊。你如果以為只是防撞包材，順手抽掉，會怎麼樣？
lines.text: I'd also pay attention to the white mat in the holder supplied with the tin. What happens if you mistake it for packing material and pull it out?

lines.source: 原廠問答說，它是玻璃纖維做的不燃墊，點燃的香就放在上面，是使用時要留下的東西。
lines.text: The maker's Q&A says it's a noncombustible fiberglass mat. The lit coil rests on it, so it stays in place during use.

lines.source: 香端如果直接碰到金屬部分，金屬會把熱帶走，就可能讓火熄掉；香體的落腳處，也參與了燃燒。
lines.text: If the burning tip touches metal directly, the metal draws heat away and may extinguish it. Where the coil rests also affects how it burns.

lines.source: 罐裝的蓋子要翻過來，讓白墊朝上，才接住點燃的香；原廠還提醒，要把附的罩子蓋好。
lines.text: Turn the tin's lid over with the white mat facing up, so it can hold the lit coil. The maker also says to put the supplied cover in place.

lines.source: 點燃之後，火為什麼能沿著香體，慢慢往前走？
lines.text: Once lit, why does the burning point move slowly along the incense?

lines.source: 金鳥工廠給的解釋在香體斷面：空隙少，氧氣不容易進去，於是慢慢燃燒。
lines.text: KINCHO's factory explains it through the cross-section: few gaps make it hard for oxygen to enter, so it burns slowly.

lines.source: 我倒想問，你拿到的一般尺寸，原廠標的是多長、能燒多久？
lines.text: I'd like to ask: for the regular size you buy, what length and burn time does the maker list?

lines.source: 現行一般尺寸，金鳥標示單卷約七十五公分，燃燒約七小時，已經是另一代規格。
lines.text: For today's regular size, KINCHO lists one coil at about 75 centimeters, with a burn time of about 7 hours: a different generation of specifications.

lines.source: 原廠還列短時與長時尺寸，燃燒時數也會隨使用環境變動。
lines.text: The maker also lists shorter- and longer-burning sizes, and burn times vary with the conditions of use.

lines.source: 燃燒往前走時，有效成分怎麼離開香體，交到空氣裡？
lines.text: As the burning point advances, how does the active ingredient leave the incense and enter the air?

lines.source: 原廠說，燃燒期間，有效成分會持續以極細微粒子的形式進入空氣。
lines.text: The maker says the active ingredient continuously enters the air as extremely fine particles while the incense burns.

lines.source: 原廠的說明把兩個位置分開。你看到香端發紅，有效成分就一定要等到那一點才離開嗎？
lines.text: The maker's explanation separates two locations. You can see the glowing tip, but must the active ingredient wait until it reaches that point to leave?

lines.source: 原廠把發紅的燃燒端，標在約攝氏七百度到八百度；成分卻從它前方的香體揮散。
lines.text: The maker puts that glowing burning tip at about 700 to 800 degrees Celsius. The ingredient, though, volatilizes from the incense ahead of it.

lines.source: 那個位置離前端約六到八毫米，溫度約攝氏二百五十度，還沒有變成你眼前的灰。
lines.text: That location is about 6 to 8 millimeters from the tip, at about 250 degrees Celsius. It hasn't yet turned into the ash you can see.

lines.source: 我會把最後一段路留給空氣。你點著以後，位置隨便放，成分就會自己走到每個角落嗎？
lines.text: I'd leave the last stretch of the journey to the air. Once you light the coil, can you put it anywhere and expect the ingredient to reach every corner?

lines.source: 原廠問答用煙的擴散範圍，作為有效範圍的線索；把香擺在風的上游，有利成分隨氣流散開。
lines.text: The maker's Q&A uses the spread of smoke as a clue to the effective range. Placing the coil upwind helps the ingredient disperse with the airflow.

lines.source: 對室內使用，問答也直接要求開窗、保持通風；香體走到房間裡，還得配合實際的使用環境。
lines.text: For indoor use, the Q&A also explicitly calls for opening windows and maintaining ventilation. Once the coil reaches your room, the actual conditions still matter.

lines.source: 一把乾花粉末要成為過夜的商品，靠的是讓材料在該留的時候留住，到了使用時，再有節奏地離開。
lines.text: Turning dried-flower powder into an overnight product means keeping material in place when it needs to stay, then letting it leave at a steady pace during use.

lines.source: 如果你曾把相連的雙卷拆斷，留言告訴我，你當時先抓的是中心，還是外緣？
lines.text: If you've snapped a coil while separating a joined pair, tell me in the comments: did you grab the center or outer edge first?

lines.source: 想看懂日用品背後這些不只靠一個好點子的選擇，歡迎訂閱這個頻道。
lines.text: To explore the choices behind everyday objects that go beyond a single good idea, subscribe to this channel.
